title: Design System: Ideas on a String

components.name: Printed program
components.description: Masthead, contents, binding gutter, Roman chapter leaf and running colophon; inline, not a modal or card.

components.name: Chapter contents
components.description: 52px native chapter buttons, Roman numerals and aria-current step; two columns on phone, four on tablet/landscape, left leaf on desktop.

components.name: Page-turn cue
components.description: Rust ink, transparent background, bottom rule; 48px target, no shadow or rounded card.

components.name: Pause stage
components.description: 100x44px target. Reduced motion: disabled Stage is still; normal motion: Pause/Resume.

extensions.preservation: Accepted geometry, material/light world, desktop camera framing and chapter copy retained.

layout.mobileLayout: Normal-flow intro, separate canvas, control rail, masthead/contents and readable leaf; no fixed desktop widgets or body lock.

motion.name: physical-fly-cue
motion.purpose: Interruptible closure/exchange/string descent; visible cut for reduced/paused.

verification.input: Trusted keyboard, touchscreen taps and mouse wheel
verification.detector: Historical single run retained, not rerun

fidelity.behavior: The proscenium and camera remain fixed. Native Previous scene / Pull next thread handles close folded fly curtains, exchange the chapter scenery, lower suspended labels and accelerate brass gears; the original bobbin follows the red thread. The printed program updates immediately and retains its entire reading/contact path. Last input wins; pause/reduced motion produce actual final scene cuts. Phone receives the same cue machinery. Normal rendering is capped at ~30fps, 1024px shadows and DPR1.5; expensive work stops offscreen/hidden. Full program available without JavaScript.
